stop_rules: each job stops on its first missed control (above); a stopped job's reads are not scored

a.rows: Both SGD teacher-trained decompositions fail rows 128-255 at seeds 1 and 2 as well: the block's fail is not one adversary start; it belongs to the rows. Next (a later $0 job, by this tree): per-row KL under the block's final mask, to say whether a handful of rows carry it.
a.start: Both SGD teacher-trained decompositions pass rows 128-255 at seeds 1 and 2: the block's fail was the adversary's start. Multi-start readings become a question for every line: a decision card for the user.
a.mixed: The SGD states do not agree, or a seed lands between the lines: start and rows are not separated on this block; the b reading decides where SGD sits, and per-row KL is not run.
a.unscored: Stage a stopped at a control, or a ratio is not finite: unanswered.

b.sgd_with_adam: Plain SGD's teacher-trained decomposition fails two or more of the four new blocks: full-matrix SGD sits with Adam, and Amendment 3's two remaining stages, option (d), go to the user as a card.
b.sgd_passes_most: Plain SGD fails at most one of the four new blocks and Adam fails all four: the line closes 'Adam fails, the LoRA passes, SGD passes on most rows'; option (d) is dropped.
b.adam_not_every_block: Plain SGD fails at most one new block, and Adam's teacher-trained decomposition also passes on at least one: Adam's fail is block-dependent too; not covered by the card's advice, so it goes to the user before anything else runs on the broad line.
b.unscored: A b job stopped at a control or did not run: unanswered.
b.sgd_passes_most_low_power: Plain SGD fails at most one of the four new blocks and Adam fails all four: the line closes 'Adam fails, the LoRA passes, SGD passes on most rows'; option (d) is dropped. But the SGD do-nothing fails at most two of the four blocks, so on the others the check could not fail SGD's update at all: the SGD passes there carry little weight, and this is said wherever the reading is.
